skirmish.module.world_map.name: World Map
skirmish.module.world_map.description: A full-screen map of where you have been (key M): the surface like a vanilla map, your waypoints and yourself. Saved per server and dimension. Surface only — no caves, players or mobs; the roofed Nether is not drawn.
skirmish.worldmap.title: Map
skirmish.worldmap.no_roof: This dimension has a roof — no map
skirmish.worldmap.hint: LMB — drag · wheel — zoom · RMB — add a waypoint
